additional_info.subject: Log Analysis
additional_info.body:
Due to DPA, at EV soc 52%, (CG Allocation Level 1 Optimization Done, EV SOC: 52 % ), EVSE_MaxCur[A]=0, thus EV changed it's target back to EV_TarCur[A]=0 , Untill EVSE increased it's current
Observed power converter error
2025-05-03T09:21:46.058353+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/a59d439365f2[737]: PLC-Error-Flag 'PowerConverter[1]' changed from false - ('2102312VGQLUP2001675SA002200000000FW:DC118PF118H100,F:1') to true - ('2102312VGQLUP2001675SA002204000208FW:DC118PF118H100,F:1,E17')    1746264109944    38942990891094633904275403277726082492796823461502189580
this is causing statusnotificaiton changing from SuspendedEV to Charging and vice versa, before EV Communication was dropped.
Can try updating the charger to v7.0.5.
Errorcode 17, is not critical Internal communicaiton error

additional_info.subject: ID0422147-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / S2 313522141002 ] Charging Interruption CRM:02684000194
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek DRIF,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Deepanshi
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / S2 313522141002
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
SMpaSh
Problem Description
: Malfunction observed on the Sicharge D charging station and showing displayed a charging error.
At the mentioned time, we observed EV was getting charged, until 52% without any issue, at this point charger used it's DPA to reduce the allocated power from 120Kw to 80kw
This resulted in a momentary reduction of EVSE max current to 0A, a sec, followed by EV also reducing the target current to 0A.
However later the charging resumed with 200A.
During this time when EV reached to 57% soc, we observed power converter error (non-critical), and again the session was suspended (not stopped)
However, after few seconds the EV dropped the communication, resulting in the interruption of charging session.
While we are further analyzing the issue, may we recommend you to update the charger to 7.0.5.
If required, we will dispatch field service team for a site visit.
For future reference, your case number is
0422147
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Deepanshi Singh

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0422147-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / S2 313522141002 ] Charging Interruption CRM:02684000194
additional_info.body:
Hello Malek,
Upon analyzing the logs for the two sessions, here is my feedback:
1st Session:
Started at 2025-05-06T07:15:49
UTC [CEST-2]
On Outlet 1 failed during Cable Check, after ChargeParamterDiscovery, EV didn't send the Cable Check request and hence session was failed.
2nd session:
Started at 2025-05-06T07:18:13
UTC [CEST-2]
Charging started successfully with EV at 71%
Current reached till 100A.
At 79% SoC, Dynamic Power Allocation was triggered, due to less power consumption by EV.
Later we observed a non-critical error from 1 power converter.
This leads to the EVSE_max current to 0
EV followed it and set it's Target Current to 0A.
Eventually the session was terminated at 84% SoC.
Refer attached summary.
We will dispatch the field service team to replace this PowerConveter, as the session is stopped, or current is set to 0A, only after the Power Converter Error appears.
@Emmanuel, for your action to dispatch the service team. I will write the MLFB of the power converter to you in a separate email.
Before replacing the converter, please inspect the input air filters, on many occasions, it has been observed that due to dust and foreign particles, power converter misbehaves and losses it's communication.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
